# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Micare shimmer abilities must use Latin names rather than English names; preserve JSONC-defined stat, rarity, item, and effect vocabulary unless explicitly asked to change it.
- The game title must be displayed as “Micare - Cathedral of Lies,” and the character name must be entered by the player and used throughout the UI instead of hardcoded “Adelaide.” UI layout must keep all text and controls non-overlapping and clearly visible.
